Experimental rationale

Raw signal & normalized inhibition

RLU is normalized against each plate's own blank and vehicle controls. No future measurements appear before the plate-read event.

Single-drug error bars are within-plate SEM. HSA appears only with same-plate matched-dose monotherapies. These replicates do not establish biological reproducibility.

Full result JSON
Revealed only after submission. Model predictions, not additional wet-lab measurements.
Fixed-seed benchmark
Same seeded worlds and 288-well cap. Baselines used 282 wells; agents allocated their own budgets. All zero-score outcomes are included.


What is being simulated?
Executed compound amounts and exposure volumes determine concentration. A shared single-drug Hill model, Bliss reference and gated Matérn GP residual predict inhibition. A fixed bootstrap model member is selected per run; a residual-calibrated measurement model generates raw luminescence.
Only supported cells, drug pairs, doses and the fixed 72-hour assay are modeled. Control means are reconstructed from the authors' normalization relationship. Control noise is an explicit modeling assumption; residuals include both measurement variation and model discrepancy.
Released-scene test metrics are acceptance metrics after scene selection, not an unbiased claim of broad generalization. This is a simulator score, not evidence of clinical efficacy or a new wet-lab discovery.
